subject.title: fix(agents-bind): generate peer format for feishu group bindings

question: Should this PR reinterpret `feishu:<value>` as a group peer with a new `feishu:account:<id>` escape, or should maintainers require a different compatibility-safe Feishu bind grammar before merge?
rationale: The current public CLI contract treats `<channel>:<account>` as account selection, so changing the meaning for Feishu affects persisted config and message routing in a way automation should not choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Require compatibility-preserving grammar
options.body: Preserve existing account and channel-only semantics, then add an explicit peer form or plugin-owned Feishu conversation detection with docs and tests.

options.title: Adopt this grammar intentionally
options.body: Accept the account escape and Feishu two-segment reinterpretation only with maintainer-approved upgrade notes, docs, and proof that existing account setups remain expressible.

options.title: Choose a sibling candidate
options.body: Pause this branch and adopt another open candidate if it better matches the desired Feishu bind contract.

recommendation.title: Require compatibility-preserving grammar
recommendation.body: Preserve existing account and channel-only semantics, then add an explicit peer form or plugin-owned Feishu conversation detection with docs and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent routing and agents CLI docs work makes this the best available owner for the public bind-contract choice among the likely owners.
